meta.description:
A symmetrical ruined cloister built around a central east-west avenue, with four chamber districts and narrow axial passages. Repeated room shapes create landmarks, while
    staggered doorways and short sightline breaks prevent the maze from becoming a featureless hall.
structural_rules: Use four repeated chamber districts arranged around a central horizontal avenue.
Separate chambers with thick wall bands and connect them through single-cell doorways.
Maintain narrow corridors along the major north-south and east-west axes.
Break long views with alternating wall segments and offset openings.
Keep the outermost ring entirely walled.
